_description: 87A marginal relief. Normal income 1225000 (salary 1300000 less 75000 standard deduction), equity STCG 20000, total taxable 1245000 (>12L). Slab tax on 1225000 = 63750 (20000 at 5% + 40000 at 10% + 3750 at 15%); STCG tax = 4000; total before rebate = 67750. The calculator measures the excess over the 12L threshold against NORMAL income only: 1225000 - 1200000 = 25000, so rebate = max(0, 63750 - 25000) = 38750 and tax after rebate = 67750 - 38750 = 29000. NOTE 1: an earlier version of this description stated 'slab tax on 1225000 = 67750' and derived rebate = 67750 - 25000 = 42750. Both were wrong — 67750 is the total BEFORE rebate, not the slab tax. The error was self-cancelling (67750 - 42750 + 4000 and 67750 - 38750 both give 29000), which is why it survived unnoticed. NOTE 2: measuring the threshold against normal income rather than total income is DISPUTED and pending adjudication against the ITD estimator. s.87A reads on 'total income', which here is 1245000; under that reading the relief would be computed from the 45000 excess, not 25000. This test currently encodes the calculator's own interpretation and is therefore NOT independent evidence that the interpretation is correct. If the estimator contradicts it, both tax_calculator.py and this test must change.
